native_abi.00697f40: ECX actual checked DWORD vector, stack value pointer, RET4; source is a storage adapter.

recovered_behavior.gate: If outer pair begin is null or signed(end-begin)>>4 is zero, populate ALL five groups; otherwise skip all modifier reads.
recovered_behavior.pairs: Append empty actual10h row before Lua index1 lookup. Lookup, integer conversion, three captured-end checks, append and destroy; repeat for index2. Then advance Lua key/value.
recovered_behavior.flat: Assign each newly looked-up table into the retained table object, destroy lookup temporary, iterate values; convert integers and append without sorting or deduplicating.
recovered_behavior.lifetime: Destroy value, key, table and InputModifiers in that order. Globals stays owned by caller until remaining Inputs parser completes.

storage_contracts.word: Existing concrete single-word insertion for growth, plus exact append fast path; opaque0 is preserved.
storage_contracts.row: Stateless source deep-copy adapter over actual checked10h rows; allocator/growth/copy/delete order established from557590,698040,698400,6988F0,698980. No STL library source port or original ABI replacement.

limitations: Full Inputs/actions parser beginning69903A and final device tick remain unimplemented by this module.
Native fixture uses real source Lua/file leaves and fixture streams, not native physical/archive VFS routing.
No original FH3 execution, malformed ranges, arbitrary stack aliases, hardware polling or game validation.
